cat > solution.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Function to check if a number is prime
is_prime() {
    local n=$1
    if [ $n -lt 2 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [ $n -eq 2 ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    if [ $((n % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    local i=3
    while [ $((i * i)) -le $n ]; do
        if [ $((n % i)) -eq 0 ]; then
            return 1
        fi
        i=$((i + 2))
    done
    return 0
}

# Get current date and calculate 7 days ago
current_date=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
seven_days_ago=$(date -d "7 days ago" +%Y-%m-%d)

total_sum=0

for file in log_files/log_server_*; do
    # Extract server ID and date from filename
    filename=$(basename "$file")
    server_id=$(echo "$filename" | grep -oP 'log_server_\K[0-9]+')
    file_date=$(echo "$filename" | grep -oP '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
    
    # Check if server ID is prime
    if is_prime "$server_id"; then
        # Check if date is within last 7 days
        if [[ "$file_date" > "$seven_days_ago" && "$file_date" <= "$current_date" ]]; then
            # Sum integers in the file
            while read -r num; do
                if [[ -n "$num" ]]; then
                    total_sum=$((total_sum + num))
                fi
            done < "$file"
        fi
    fi
done

echo "$total_sum"
EOF
chmod +x solution.sh
bash solution.sh
